== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
=== Stellar Data ===
'''Corinna''' has a solitary primary star.
* It is a yellow main sequence.
 
{{MonostellarSystem
|name           = Corinna
|primary        = G1 V
|PrimaryName    = Primary
|PrimaryNotes   = 
}}

=== System Data ===
The worlds of the [[system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
* The [[mainworld]].
* x8 secondary [[world|rocky worlds]].
* x3 [[gas giant]]s.

=== Mainworld Data ===

==== [[Planetary Size|Mainworld Size]] (S) ====
{{WorldSize|name= Corinna|Size= 6}}

==== [[Atmosphere|Mainworld Atmosphere]] (A) ====
{{WorldAtmo|name= Corinna|Atmosphere= 8}}
* It experiences [[Celsius|generally moderate temperatures]].

==== [[Hydrosphere|Mainworld Hydrosphere]] (H) ====
{{WorldHydro|name= Corinna|Hydrosphere= 7}}

==== Satellites ====
'''Corinna''' retains a single [[Natural Satellite|small moon]] named ''Bone''.
* It orbits once every few days.

[[File:Alien Moon 17d-1.jpg|600 px]]

==== Mainworld Geography and Topography ====
No centrally held map of the world exists within [[Argushiigi Admegulasha Bilanidin|AAB]] [[Library Data]] records.

Corinna is a relatively young world, like many in this subsector. Active tectonics are creating three major mountain ranges and numerous archipelagos and islands.

[[File:Blank World Map Watery.png|500 px]] <br> (''Blank map, predominantly watery world''.)

==== Native Lifeforms ====
Abundant [[Lifeform|native life]] occupying every available ecological niche. Its metabolic functions drive the process of atmospheric renewal.

At least two forms of bipedal tree-dwelling creatures have been found thus far, and both display significant levels of intelligence without being [[sophont]].
* Colonies of these species seem to be clustered around the ruins of [[Neozinga]] urban centers.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
[[File:Comp-Prog-Dav-R-Deitrick-Starter-Trav-Page-16 16-July-2018a.jpg|right]]
'''Corinna''' is a [[Reserve World]] with restricted access to certain areas of the surface, largely in place to interdict the many ruined cities on the world. These are considered to be war graves.
* Some are being archaeologically studied.

==== Native Sophont ====
The [[Neozinga]] were a [[minor race]] native to the world: ''[[Neozinga]]'' is the [[Solomani]] term for this species, which have been classified as [[non-humanoid]] walkers. More specifically, [[Neozinga]] were a winged [[insectoid]] / [[arthropodoid]] analog, massing between [[Kilogram|25 and 50 kg]], with a body length of approximately [[Meter|1 meter]], and while primarily adapted to walking were capable of short bursts of flight. Feeding was achieved by a long, sharp proboscis, much like that of a [[Terran]] mosquito. Venom could also be injected via separate fangs. There are some indications that there was a [[psionic]] element to feeding, but there is little solid evidence of this.

[[File:Neozinga Sophont.jpg|300 px]]

During the [[Solomani Rim War|Rim War]] the [[Solomani Confederation|Confederation]] attempted to "relocate" a number of non-human races to other worlds, principally to fill gaps in the labor market caused by humans serving in the military. The [[Neozinga]] were always unpredictable around humans and actively resisted these relocation efforts. Following increasing numbers of violent episodes against [[Solomani]] citizens and communities, culminating in open attacks on [[Solomani Confederation|Confederation]] interests and a planetary uprising that threatened to engulf other worlds in the region, the [[Neozinga]] civilization was obliterated by orbital bombardment. Their now-ruinous cities are difficult for humans to navigate, as both walking and flying are required for various locations.

The nature of [[Neozinga]] culture is not well-understood, but appears to have been highly cooperative, but within highly competitive tribes.
* Rumors persist that isolated, hidden communities of [[Neozinga]] still survive in the deep wildernesses of the world.

[[Solomani Security]] keeps a close eye on things to ensure the security of the [[Solomani Confederation|Confederation]] and the well-being of its loyal citizens. Almost anyone ''could'' be a [[Solomani Security|SolSec]] informant, passing on all sorts of useful information: some gain a reward or benefit for their actions, others are coerced, but many see it as an act of duty to help protect the [[Solomani Confederation|Solomani state]] and its interests.

=== [[Starport|World Starport]] (St) ===
{{Starport|name= Corinna|Starport= B}}

''Ton Bleu'' is an [[Highport|orbital complex]] rated as a [[Starport|Class B]] [[highport]], with a population of approximately 800.
* Sol Corinna is the orbital [[Military Base]] for the [[mainworld]]. Its population is estimated at 1200.

=== [[Population|World Population]] (P) ===
{{WorldPop|name= Corinna|multiplier= 2|Population= 4}}
* More than 95% of the population (in excess of 19,000 individuals) consists of [[Solomani]] humans.
* Less than 5% of the population (fewer than a thousand individuals) is made up of [[Dolphin]]s.

[[File:Dolphin Liz Danforth 1980 JTAS06 p38.jpg|250 px|right]]

==== Urbanization ====
'''Corinna ''' has two primary population centers, both human-built:  
* ''Corris'' ([[Starport|Class B]] [[downport]] / population 14,000), a coastal settlement populated by [[Ivraie (world)|Ivraien]] colonists.
* ''Vertis'' ([[Spaceport|Class G]] [[downport]] / population 6,000).

The local government is maintaining cultural centers, streets, electrical grids, wire/wireless communication, and a decent Worldnet. This infrastructure is clustered around Corris and Vertis, with only beaten paths to outlying homesteads. That said, local populations are making use of the damaged [[Neozinga]] roadways when possible, particularly when doing research in the ruins of the major urban center near Corris.

==== Linguistic Topography ====
The most commonly heard [[language]]s are:
* [[Delphinic Trinary]], the principal language of [[Dolphin]]s.
* [[Euxene French (language)|Euxene French]], a [[Terran]] language principally spoken in the [[Euxene Cluster]].
* [[Rim Anglic]], a dialect of [[Anglic]] and the principal language of the [[Solomani Confederation|Confederation]].

{{WorldTech|name= Corinna|WorldTech= A}}

=== [[Government|World Government]] (G) ===
{{WorldGov|name= Corinna|Government= 6}}

==== World Military ====
A [[military base]] is maintained and operated by the [[Solomani Confederation]] military as an [[Space Station|orbital installation]].

Armed patrols are periodically launched to monitor [[Neozinga]] urban centers and sites for signs of illegal activity.

=== [[Law Level|World Law]] (L) ===
{{WorldLaw|name= Corinna|Law= 4}}

=== Trade Data ===
* [[Importance Extension|Importance]]: 1 (ordinary)

=== World Economy ===
Corinna has a gross planetary product of 4 [[BCr]], with a relatively high per-capita income. Trade is centered around foodstuffs export, tourism, and cultural archaeology.

* [[Resource]]s:                       C (very abundant)
* [[Labor]]:                           3 (thousands)
* [[Infrastructure]]:                  3 (very limited)
* [[Efficiency]]:                      -3 (poor)

=== World Culture ===
The population of the world is descended from colonists principally originating on [[Ivraie (world)|Ivraie]], with significant minorities from [[Elysee (world)|Elysee]] and [[Hypericum (world)|Hypericum]]. The world has a strongly [[Ivraie (world)|Ivraien]] culture.

* [[Homogeneity|Heterogenity]]:        4 (harmonious)
* [[Acceptance]]:                      5 (very aloof)
* [[Strangeness]]:                     7 (confusing)
* [[Symbol]]s:                         9 (somewhat abstract)

==== World Timeline ====
Major events that have affected this world and the wider region that it lies within:

* [[-9235]]: far to [[coreward]], the [[Vilani]] discover [[jump drive]] technology. Over the centuries pioneers and settlers gradually spread across [[Charted Space]].
* [[-4045]] to [[-2204]]: the [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]] controls vast territories.
* [[-2431]]: [[Terran]]s discover [[jump drive]] technology.
* [[-2404]] to [[-2215]]: the [[Interstellar Wars]].
* [[-2204]] to [[-1776]]: the [[Rule of Man]] administers the former [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]].
* [[-1776]] to [[0]]: the [[Long Night]].
* [[0|The Year 0]]: to [[coreward]], the [[Third Imperium]] is founded.
* [[300]]-[[420]]: the {{Imperial}} [[First Survey]] charts the system.
* [[604]]-[[622]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Civil War]].
* [[624]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Express Boat Network]] is established.
* [[704]]: the [[Solomani Autonomous Region]] is formed.
* [[800]]-[[820]]: the [[Psionics Suppressions]].
* [[871]]: the [[Solomani Confederation]] is founded.
* [[940]]: the [[Solomani Autonomous Region]] is dissolved.
* [[990]]-[[1002]]: the [[Solomani Rim War]].
* [[995]]-[[1065]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Second Survey]] includes data for the system.
* [[1065]]: the [[Second Survey]] is published. Information about the system becomes widely available.
